_comment: REFERENCE list of every learnable skill on this server, grouped by job tree. NOT a loadout — copy only the lines your character actually uses.
_usage:
1) Find your class in the groups below (or Ctrl+F for a skill name). 2) Paste them INTO client/presets.json under YOUR character name (whole entry, as-is):
   "mara": [ {"name":"AB_CANTO","id":2042}, {"name":"CD_REPARATIO","id":5268} ].
You can paste WHOLE entries from this file as-is — extra fields (type/desc) are fine; presets.json reads only name+id. The server itself only honors skills your character has learned, so unlearned lines are skipped harmlessly.
